interaction.model_response: I'll make two commits, code first and then the roadmap, so the roadmap is easy to drop if you'd rather not track it:

tool_executions.arguments:
{"command":"git add CLAUDE.md commands.go fs.go model.go msg.go update.go fs_test.go update_test.go && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Make copy, move and delete safe to use

- Mark the synthetic ".." entry with IsParent and exclude it from
  selection and from every operation; Alt+D on ".." used to run
  os.RemoveAll on the parent directory.
- Plan copy/move batches before touching anything: planBatch splits
  them into clean files, conflicts and rejected files (source equal to
  destination, a directory into itself). Copying with both panes on the
  same directory used to truncate the source files to zero bytes.
- Resolve overwrite conflicts one file at a time and run the whole batch
  (clean + overwritten) once every conflict is decided. Previously
  answering the first prompt overwrote all remaining conflicts, and
  non-conflicting files in a batch with conflicts were silently dropped.
- transferFiles re-checks the safety rules and reports every error
  instead of stopping at the first one.
- Add fs_test.go and update_test.go, the first tests in the repo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git add "Twin — Roadmap.md" && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Add roadmap with verified bug list and progress

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log --oneline -3 && git status --short","description":"Commit code changes and roadmap separately"}
